scenario.handoff.text: Ready. You are now the {role}. Try the next step yourself.

scenario.finished.text: Done. The scenario ran to its end.

scenario.s1.try.text: Accept the quote, pay the deposit, then follow the job to the rating.

scenario.s2.try.text: Read the deadlines, jump the clock past one, or mark the payment as received.

scenario.s3card.try.text: As the professional, request additional work. The customer approves it first.

scenario.s3cash.try.text: Request additional work. The job cannot be completed until its reference is paid.

scenario.s4.try.text: See the surcharge and the full amount due soon. Jump the clock to let it expire.

scenario.s5.try.text: See the follow-up deadline, then approve or decline the address as Admin.

scenario.s6acc.try.text: A request is waiting. Switch to the professional and accept the new time.

scenario.s6dec.try.text: A request is waiting. Decline it as the professional and keep the current time.

scenario.s6exp.try.text: Jump the clock 12 hours. Then choose a replacement or a refund.

scenario.s7pre.try.text: Cancel the job. It is free, with a full refund.

scenario.s7post.try.text: Cancel the job. The travel fee applies and the rest is refunded.

scenario.s8cancel.try.text: As the professional, read the score warning, then cancel.

scenario.s8noshow.try.text: Use the demo panel to trigger a no-show, then choose a replacement or a refund.

scenario.s9.try.text: Report an issue on one item, then follow the case and its reviews.

scenario.s10.try.text: Open the Warranty tab and file a claim.

scenario.s11.try.text: Verify a new professional, then recover the account after losing the number.

scenario.s12.try.text: Chat with the demo lines and see the automatic translations and their labels.
